response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang skills, but the role demands native-level Japanese, deep C programming for UNIX, Linux kernel source-code analysis and modification, and embedded networking security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching) — none of which are evidenced. His only C/C++ exposure was a brief 7-month stint in 2014-2015, and his listed languages (English, Romanian, German) do not include Japanese, which is a hard requirement. The profile does not match this embedded LAN-switch security position.
strengths: Long, diverse software engineering career (15+ years) with strong general development fundamentals
Some low-level/systems exposure: DLang low-latency services, C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux experience
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, testing tools authorship) and knowledge-sharing track record
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency — a hard requirement (native level)
No embedded firmware, networking protocol (L2/L3, MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF), or Linux kernel development experience
C programming experience is minimal and dated; recent career is entirely web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js)

key_factors.factor: No embedded/networking/security or Linux kernel experience
